meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会接受你的已有视频（采访/播客等），自动分析转录文本，设计并叠加动态图形卡片（标题、引用、数据等），最终生成带覆盖层的MP4视频。
howto.when: 当你说出“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”等关键词，或要求“包装我的视频”时触发。

say.text: 帮我的采访视频加上动态标题卡片。
say.note: Claude会分析视频并设计标题卡片叠加。

say.text: 给这个播客视频设计引用和侧边栏覆盖层。
say.note: Claude会生成引用和侧边栏图形。

say.text: 为视频添加数据标注和画中画效果。
say.note: Claude会同步数据卡片到对应时间点。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will accept your existing video (interview/podcast etc.), automatically transcribe it, design and overlay animated graphic cards (titles, quotes, data callouts, etc.), and output a new MP4 with overlays.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or ask to "package/dress up my video".

say_en.text: Add dynamic title cards to my interview video.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and designs title overlays.

say_en.text: Design quote and side-panel overlays for this podcast.
Add data callouts and picture-in-picture to my video.
say_en.note: Claude syncs data cards to timestamps.
